## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sabari Catering Services?
35/31, State Bank Colony Extension, 1st Cross Street, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061.

### What facilities does Sabari Catering Services have?
Iyer wedding menu, Iyengar wedding menu, Telugu Brahmin menu, Kerala menu, Seemantham menu, Ayush homam & poojas, Grihapravesam, Mangalavadhyam, Mandapa kolam, Flowers & garlands, Kasiyatra arrangements, Bakshanam & paruppu thengai, Name-printed thamboolam bags, Coffee, tea & chat stalls, Photo & videography.

### Is the food pure vegetarian?
Yes. Sabari is a 100% pure vegetarian caterer, specialising in Tamil Brahmin cuisine for Iyer and Iyengar families.

### Do you cater homams and poojas?
Yes, with menus for Ayush Homam, Ganapathi Homam and Navagraha Pooja, and no-onion, no-garlic viratham menus.

### How do I book Sabari Catering Services for my function?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98412 38468.
